messages.content: Please recheck Fairmont and MacArthur Place for May 31 through June 3. I want the actual three-night cost, including mandatory fees, taxes, parking, breakfast, and two spa treatments. The spa timing is what will decide this, so do not rely only on the online calendar.

I’ll compare the Fairmont breakfast package with MacArthur Place’s standard king rate, since those are the closest available choices from the shortlist. For the treatments, should I check Saturday afternoon for two people, with appointments beginning between 1:00 and 4:00 p.m.?
Yes. They can start within half an hour of each other; they do not have to be in the same room. Use one 60-minute massage and one 60-minute facial for the comparison.

The updated Fairmont package is $655 per night and includes breakfast for two and self-parking. Its mandatory resort fee is $49 nightly. MacArthur Place is still $795 per night; it has a $65 nightly destination fee, and parking is $45 nightly. Breakfast is not included in that MacArthur rate. MacArthur’s spa has confirmed openings at 2:00 and 2:15 p.m. Saturday. Fairmont’s public calendar still does not show a workable pair, so I am checking the spa’s internal availability before treating it as viable.
Before we decide, itemize the full totals. Include the spa service charge or gratuity if it is automatic, and tell me exactly how each room can be canceled.

Fairmont: room $1,965; resort fees $147; estimated lodging taxes $300; parking $0; included breakfast $0 additional. The massage and facial total $510, plus a 20% automatic service charge of $102. Estimated trip total is $3,024. The room may be canceled without penalty until 4:00 p.m. seven days before arrival; after that, the penalty is one night plus tax.

MacArthur Place: room $2,385; destination fees $195; parking $135; estimated lodging taxes $366; breakfast for two over three mornings estimated at $210. The two treatments total $490, plus a 22% automatic service charge of about $108. Estimated trip total is $3,889. The room requires cancellation 14 days before arrival to avoid forfeiting the one-night deposit.
So Fairmont is about $865 less, but we still do not know whether the spa works. Were you able to get anything firmer than the website?

Yes. The Fairmont spa confirmed a 2:30 p.m. massage and a 2:45 p.m. facial on Saturday, June 1. Both are 60 minutes. Those appointments are not being held yet. Spa cancellations made at least 24 hours in advance have no charge; later cancellations and no-shows are charged in full. The quoted treatment prices and 20% service charge were also confirmed directly.
Does MacArthur give us any more flexibility on the treatments, or is its advantage simply that the times were easier to confirm?

MacArthur has the broader Saturday schedule: it could place both treatments at 2:00 p.m., or stagger them at 2:00 and 2:15. Its spa cancellation deadline is 48 hours, after which the full treatment cost applies. Fairmont offers only the 2:30 and 2:45 pairing in your requested window, but that pairing satisfies the timing you gave me.
Is there a defensible reason to spend the extra $865 at MacArthur for this trip? I do not want the answer based on the advertised room rate alone.

Only if the smaller property and perfectly simultaneous treatment option are worth that premium to you. On the complete package, MacArthur costs about 29% more, has the stricter room and spa cancellation deadlines, and does not offset the difference with breakfast or parking. Since Fairmont now has two confirmed treatment times only 15 minutes apart, Fairmont is the stronger fit for this trip.
Agreed. Make Fairmont the choice and remove MacArthur from the active shortlist. Do not reserve anything yet. I need to confirm one schedule item with my spouse tonight.

Fairmont Sonoma Mission Inn is now the selected option for May 31-June 3, with the breakfast-and-parking package and the Saturday 2:30 p.m. massage and 2:45 p.m. facial identified. Nothing has been reserved or held. MacArthur Place has been removed from the active shortlist. The estimated complete cost is $3,024, subject to availability and a final rate and tax check when you are ready to book.
